svg.aria-label: Author (context): Publishes posts. Post service (context): Writes source posts. Post store (context): Source posts and timelines. Reader (in focus): Reads a page of posts. Feed service (in focus): Builds and filters pages. Follow store (context): Follower relationships. Fan-out queue (context): Buffers follower updates. Feed store (in focus): Prepared feed references. Policy service (added) (in focus): Checks current visibility. Fail closed if access is unknown. Flow: Reader to Feed service: Request next page. Feed service to Feed store: Read feed entries. Feed service to Policy service: Check access. Feed service to Reader: Return allowed posts.
